metadata.dataset: Striver SDE Sheet — original metadata/test data
metadata.note: Descriptions and hints are newly written; third-party editorial/problem text is not reproduced.

problem.title: Implement Stack using Arrays
problem.description: Implement a LIFO stack using an array.
hints: Track the top index and handle empty operations.

problem.title: Implement Queue using Arrays
problem.description: Implement a FIFO queue using an array.
hints: Use front/rear indices; circular storage avoids shifting.

problem.title: Implement Stack using Queue
problem.description: Implement LIFO behavior using FIFO queue operations.
hints: Rotate existing elements behind the newly pushed value.

problem.title: Implement Queue using Stack
problem.description: Implement FIFO behavior using two stacks.
hints: Transfer to the output stack only when it is empty.

problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.description: Check whether brackets are correctly nested and matched.
hints: Push opening brackets and match every closing bracket against the top.

problem.title: Next Greater Element
problem.description: Find the first greater value to the right of each array element.
hints: Scan from right to left and remove useless stack candidates.

problem.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problem.description: Find the largest rectangle that can be formed under a histogram.
hints: Maintain increasing bar indices and finalize rectangles when height decreases.

problem.title: Sliding Window Maximum
problem.description: Return the maximum value in every window of size k.
hints: Keep candidate indices in decreasing value order.

problem.title: LRU Cache
problem.description: Design a cache with O(1) average get and put operations and least-recently-used eviction.
hints: Combine a hash map with a doubly linked list.

problem.title: Min Stack
problem.description: Support push, pop, top and minimum retrieval in constant time.
hints: Track the minimum for each stack level or use a second stack.

problem.title: Binary Tree Traversals
problem.description: Return preorder, inorder and postorder traversals.
hints: Follow the exact visitation order for each traversal.

problem.title: Level Order Traversal
problem.description: Return binary-tree values level by level.
hints: Process the queue one level at a time.

problem.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problem.description: Find the maximum number of nodes on a root-to-leaf path.
hints: Depth is one plus the larger child depth.

problem.title: Check Balanced Binary Tree
problem.description: Check whether every node has subtree height difference at most one.
hints: Return height while propagating an imbalance sentinel.

problem.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problem.description: Find the longest path between any two nodes, measured in edges.
hints: Combine left and right heights at every node.

testCases.expectedOutput: 0 or 1 depending on tie rule; larger index wins

problem.title: Identical Binary Trees
problem.description: Check whether two binary trees have identical structure and values.
hints: Compare null structure, values and both children.

problem.title: Zigzag Level Order Traversal
problem.description: Return tree levels alternately from left-to-right and right-to-left.
hints: Perform BFS and reverse alternate levels or fill them backward.

problem.title: Boundary Traversal of Binary Tree
problem.description: Return the outer boundary without duplicates.
hints: Collect left boundary, leaves, then reversed right boundary.

problem.title: Vertical Order Traversal
problem.description: Group nodes by vertical column using row and value ordering.
hints: Assign row/column coordinates and group by column.

problem.title: Top View of Binary Tree
problem.description: Return the first visible node at every horizontal distance.
hints: BFS makes the first encountered node the shallowest candidate.

problem.title: Bottom View of Binary Tree
problem.description: Return the visible node at every horizontal distance from below.
hints: Store the latest value encountered for each column.

problem.title: Left View of Binary Tree
problem.description: Return the first visible node at every depth from the left.
hints: Take the first node of each BFS level.

problem.title: Right View of Binary Tree
problem.description: Return the last visible node at every depth from the right.
hints: Take the last node of each BFS level.

problem.title: Symmetric Binary Tree
problem.description: Check whether a binary tree is its own mirror.
hints: Compare opposite children recursively.

problem.title: Root to Node Path
problem.description: Return the path from the root to a target node.
hints: Append before descent and remove the node when a branch fails.

problem.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of Binary Tree
problem.description: Find the lowest node containing both target nodes in its subtree.
hints: Return matches upward; two non-null child results identify the LCA.

problem.title: Maximum Path Sum in Binary Tree
problem.description: Find the maximum sum over any simple path.
hints: Only the larger positive child contribution can continue upward.

problem.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
problem.description: Serialize a binary tree and reconstruct an equivalent tree.
hints: Include null markers so tree structure is preserved.

problem.title: Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Preorder
problem.description: Reconstruct a tree from preorder and inorder traversals.
hints: Preorder supplies roots and an inorder index map supplies subtree boundaries.

problem.title: Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder
problem.description: Reconstruct a tree from inorder and postorder traversals.
hints: Postorder's last value is a root; use inorder positions to split.

problem.title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
problem.description: Transform a tree into its preorder sequence using right pointers.
hints: Process in reverse preorder or use a stack; clear left pointers.

problem.title: Morris Inorder Traversal
problem.description: Perform inorder traversal without recursion or an auxiliary stack.
hints: Temporarily thread inorder predecessors and remove each thread afterward.

problem.title: Binary Tree Maximum Width
problem.description: Find the maximum width counting null-position gaps between end nodes.
hints: Assign complete-tree indices and normalize them per level.

problem.title: Search in Binary Search Tree
problem.description: Find a target value in a binary search tree.
hints: Move left for smaller targets and right for larger ones.

problem.title: Ceil in a BST
problem.description: Find the smallest BST value greater than or equal to a target.
hints: Record a candidate and move left when the current value is large enough.

problem.title: Floor in a BST
problem.description: Find the largest BST value less than or equal to a target.
hints: Record a candidate and move right when the current value is small enough.

problem.title: Insert into BST
problem.description: Insert a unique value while preserving BST ordering.
hints: Walk until the correct null child position is found.

problem.title: Delete Node in BST
problem.description: Delete a value while preserving BST ordering.
hints: Handle zero/one child directly; replace a two-child node with its successor or predecessor.

problem.title: Kth Smallest Element in BST
problem.description: Return the kth smallest BST value.
hints: Inorder traversal visits BST values in ascending order.

problem.title: Kth Largest Element in BST
problem.description: Return the kth largest BST value.
hints: Reverse inorder visits BST values in descending order.

problem.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problem.description: Determine whether a binary tree satisfies strict BST ordering.
hints: Carry valid lower and upper bounds down each subtree.

problem.title: LCA in BST
problem.description: Find the lowest common ancestor of two values in a BST.
hints: If both targets lie on one side, move there; otherwise the current node is the split point.

problem.title: Two Sum in BST
problem.description: Determine whether two distinct BST values sum to a target.
hints: Use ascending and descending iterators as two sorted streams.

problem.title: Recover BST
problem.description: Two BST values have been swapped; restore the ordering.
hints: Inorder traversal should be sorted, so locate the inversion nodes.

problem.title: Largest BST in Binary Tree
problem.description: Find the size of the largest subtree that is also a BST.
hints: Return validity, size, minimum and maximum together from each subtree.

problem.title: Graph BFS
problem.description: Traverse a graph breadth-first from a starting vertex.
hints: Mark vertices when they enter the queue.

problem.title: Graph DFS
problem.description: Traverse a graph depth-first from a starting vertex.
hints: Mark each vertex before exploring its neighbors.

problem.title: Detect Cycle in Undirected Graph
problem.description: Determine whether an undirected graph contains a cycle.
hints: A visited neighbor other than the parent indicates a cycle.

problem.title: Detect Cycle in Directed Graph
problem.description: Determine whether a directed graph contains a cycle.
hints: An edge to a currently active recursion-stack node creates a cycle.

problem.title: Topological Sort
problem.description: Return a valid ordering of a directed acyclic graph.
hints: Repeatedly process zero-indegree vertices; incomplete processing means a cycle.
